main_text.l: primat, ut in Ecclesiâ infimum locum
bat contra verbum Dei, cujus nos
stione præcedente à nobis factum est.

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to the first word as "Egimus". The title is set in mixed roman, italic and spaced capitals; long s has been normalised to s.
